Welcome to the Orange County Lettings documentation!

Project Description

The project is a web application that allows users to browse user profiles and real estate rental listings.

Project Installation

  1. Clone the GitHub repository.

  2. Create a virtual environment: python -m venv venv.

  3. Activate the environment and install dependencies: pip install -r requirements.txt.

Quick Start Guide

To run the project locally: Execute python manage.py runserver and go to http://localhost:8000.

Technologies and Languages

  • Python 3.x

  • Django 3.x

  • SQLite (local)

  • Docker / GitHub Actions / Render

Database Structure

The database is divided into two main applications: - Lettings: Contains the Address and Letting models. - Profiles: Contains the Profile model linked to the Django User model.

Programming Interfaces (Docstrings)

Profiles Application

Views

profiles.views.index(request)

Displays a list of all user profiles.

profiles.views.profile(request, username)

Displays the details of a specific user profile.

Models

class profiles.models.Profile(*args, **kwargs)

Model representing a user profile.

Lettings Application

Views

lettings.views.index(request)

Displays a list of all lettings.

lettings.views.letting(request, letting_id)

Displays the details of a specific letting based on its ID.

Models

class lettings.models.Address(*args, **kwargs)

Model representing a physical address.

class lettings.models.Letting(*args, **kwargs)

Model representing a letting, linked to an address.

User Guide

  • Users: Browse the home page, view the list of lettings and profiles.

  • Administrators: Log in to /admin to add or modify lettings and profiles.

Deployment and Management

Deployment is automated via a CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions. On every push to the master branch, the code is tested, a Docker image is built and pushed to Docker Hub, and the application is deployed on Render.
